messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight check FAILED for release infra-service v1.34.0 -> staged
- reason: values merge conflict detected: key "db.migrations.enabled" differs between commits 8a3f... and 9b7c...
- blocked: canary rollout paused
- logs: https://ci.internal/reports/infra/1862345678

alex: huh, I thought we reverted that migration flag in the other branch. which PRs?

sam: PR #4823 and #4831 touched the same values.yaml, different envs. #4823 set migrations:true, #4831 set migrations:false — both landed on release.

maria: yeah, helm dry-run shows a configmap hash mismatch too, so chart/render output diverged.

jessica: can we apply a values override for the canary to force migrations:false and proceed? minimal blast radius.

alex: risk is db schema drift if migrations:false skips needed migration. what's the migration safety story?

sam: the migrations in #4823 are additive and idempotent, but we should run them manually in the candidate cluster before exposing traffic.

maria: propose plan: 1) pin chart to 1.33.7 for the staged canary (avoid chart changes), 2) apply a canary values override: db.migrations.enabled:false, 3) run manual migrate job in prod-candidate, 4) re-run canary. If issues -> rollback to previous revision.

jessica: sounds good. who will own the manual job?

alex: @sam can you run the migration job after we patch?

sam: ack. I'll run it at 12:15 UTC. I'll use:
```bash
kubectl create job migrate-db-186234 --from=cronjob/db-migrator -n infra
kubectl wait --for=condition=complete job/migrate-db-186234 -n infra --timeout=600s
```

deploy-bot: noted. Scheduled re-run of preflight with override values at 1862345800.

maria: also adding a short release note: "Temporarily disabling automatic migrations during staged canary to reconcile conflicting values." I'll draft in the release notes doc.

alex: if anything looks off we roll the release back to chart 1.33.6 and abort. agreed?

jessica: agreed. I'll watch the canary dashboard and the alerts channel.

-- 45m later --

deploy-bot: preflight re-run RESULT: SUCCESS (override values applied). canary resumed. run_id: deploy-1862345800

sam: migration job completed with exit=0 ✅

maria: pushed the release note draft: https://docs/release/notes/infra/1.34.0-draft

alex: thanks team. created cleanup ticket REL-1129 to remove the temporary pin/override post-release.

jessica: watching for regressions — will escalate immediately if anything spikes. :eyes:
